scoreThreshold.purpose: Detections at or above this score count as reliable observations (first ByteTrack association, object lists, scene model).
scoreThreshold.ref: F1-optimal operating point on coco128 for the letterboxed fast detector: P 0.771, R 0.412, F1 0.537 (docs/benchmarks/detector_eval_coco128.json).

lowScoreFloor.purpose: Lowest score requested from MediaPipe. Detections between this and scoreThreshold are only used to keep existing tracks alive (ByteTrack second association), never to create objects.
lowScoreFloor.ref: ByteTrack uses 0.1 with YOLOX (YOLOX precision at 0.1 on coco128: 0.531). The fast detector reaches a similar precision between 0.15 (0.427) and 0.20 (0.588); 0.15 keeps more recall for occluded objects.

maxResults.purpose: Maximum detections MediaPipe returns per frame (after its NMS).
maxResults.ref: Indoor scenes rarely exceed 20 objects above the low floor; caps worst-case tracker cost.

nmsIou.purpose: IoU threshold of MediaPipe's class-agnostic non-maximum suppression for this model (not settable from the web API; recorded for reference).
nmsIou.ref: mediapipe/tasks/cc/vision/object_detector/proto/object_detector_options.proto: min_suppression_threshold default 0.3, multiclass_nms default false; the model has no in-model NMS.

inputSize.ref: YOLOX README (YOLOX-s size 640) and the ONNX input shape [1,3,640,640].

padValue.purpose: Grey value used to pad the letterboxed input.

channelOrder.purpose: Channel order expected by the network.
channelOrder.ref: YOLOX ONNX demo reads images with OpenCV (BGR). Measured: RGB input turns a photo of oranges into a single 'vase'.

preNmsScore.purpose: Candidates below this (objectness x class probability) are dropped before NMS.

nmsIou.purpose: IoU threshold of YOLOX non-maximum suppression.

classAgnosticNms.purpose: Suppress overlapping boxes regardless of class.

scoreThreshold.purpose: Deep detections at or above this score are reported and fused into the scene.
scoreThreshold.ref: F1-optimal on coco128 (P 0.772, R 0.598, F1 0.674); also the YOLOX demo's visualisation threshold (0.3).

matchIou.purpose: A deep detection confirms a tracked object when their boxes overlap at least this much and the classes are compatible.
matchIou.ref: Same IoU gate ByteTrack uses for unconfirmed tracks (linear_assignment thresh 0.7 on IoU distance).

deepOnlyMinScore.purpose: Deep detections without a tracked counterpart become scene objects only above this score.
deepOnlyMinScore.ref: YOLOX precision on coco128 is 0.825 at 0.40; objects the fast detector never saw need stronger evidence.

relabelMargin.purpose: A deep detection replaces a tracked object's class only if its score exceeds the track's score by this margin.
relabelMargin.ref: Prevents label flip-flops between two similar scores.
